registration_type: Execution-order registration for previously fixed protocols and tasks

timing_of_registration.qualification: The execution order was decided in the earlier orchestrator instruction before candidate 9 training success or final outcome. The first final summary existed and the orchestrator had reviewed it before this registration file was written. This file records that prior decision after the first outcome; it is not claimed to be a pre-outcome registration. The registration writer read the task definition, frozen protocols/manifests and summary file metadata, not summary contents.

task_spec_hash_encoding: UTF-8 JSON, sorted keys, compact separators
execution_policy: All remaining trials run serially on the same CPU with no concurrent heavy computation; baseline batching within a trial remains allowed by the fixed protocol.
retention_policy: Preserve all development artifacts separately. Retain and report every eligible confirmation trial, including failures and timeouts; no outcome-dependent replacement, exclusion, or sample expansion.
quality_policy: Original task thresholds remain fixed. Calibration requires matching measured training quality plus fresh held-out verification. A short failed run is not a timing win.
measurement_policy: Report startup-inclusive and agent-only wall time, input/output tokens and cached/reasoning subsets without double counting, candidate/process counts and independently verified quality.

execution_order_decision.basis: The exact 18-run order was fixed in the orchestrator message before the first subsequent clock reading at 09:30:42 UTC. The exact message wall timestamp is unavailable. This decision preceded the first final outcome; the file itself did not predate trial launch.
